As the app suggested, I set up a recurring “Work Time” block from 9 A. M. to 5 P. M. and selected every social app I ever use.
At the scheduled time, those apps go gray on my home screen and remain that way all day.
Every time I’m frustrated that I can’t look at Instagram on my phone, I just think, surely I, a human adult, can wait a few more hours to see my friends’ dog photos – 5 P. M. isn’t that far away.
